root_causes.description: Flux exceptions indicate potential gaps in variance analysis processes, with 17 exceptions identified.
root_causes.financial_impact: No material exceptions exceeding $50K identified, but cumulative risk from 17 exceptions requires attention.

remediations.action: Enhance variance analysis procedures by implementing stricter thresholds and automated alerts for flux exceptions.
remediations.estimated_effort: 2 weeks for process review and automation setup, involving 1-2 FTEs.
remediations.success_criteria: Reduction in flux exceptions to <5 per period and improved variance analysis accuracy.
